all_episodes.caption: All eight previously consumed development conditions and four paired arms. Cells report safe task completion, Euclidean endpoint error, elapsed physical duration and the unchanged G500 verdict. A cutoff is not a completion time; the maximum observation is 600 s. These are selected conditions, not independent reliability trials.

stop_and_bias.caption: Control-time aligned trajectories of the two preselected far-field cases, with all recorded samples and no smoothing. Top: true goal error (the dotted line is the original 0.12 m task tolerance). Bottom: signed controller displacement error along x. Circles indicate first HOLD; traces end at their actual termination. Different arms follow different trajectories, so these curves are not a same-input estimator comparison.

prior_error_accounting.caption: Exact signed error accounting from the first usable reference readout to first HOLD on the eight original recorded trajectories: initial error plus roster changes plus common-voter increment error equals total displacement error. Every case has one uninterrupted common-voter segment. The components are correlated bookkeeping terms, not independently identified causal effects. No extra simulation is represented.

sampling: Full recorded control-time rows; no smoothing or synthetic points. Statistical unit is a condition block, not a frame.
